module origen_111162 #(
    parameter CLK_PER_HALF_BIT = 434,
    parameter INST_SIZE = 10,
    parameter BRAM_SIZE = 18,
    parameter TX_SIZE = 12
)(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rstn,
    input wire is_out,
    input wire memtoreg,
    input wire [31:0] douta,
    input wire [31:0] d,
    input wire [4:0] rd,
    output reg txd,
    output wire [31:0] dtowrite
);

    reg [8:0] txbuffer [TX_SIZE*TX_SIZE-1:0];
    reg [TX_SIZE-1:0] txbot, txtop;
    reg txwait;
    reg tx_start;
    wire tx_busy;

    assign dtowrite = d;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rstn) begin
        if (!rstn) begin
            txbot <= 0;
            txtop <= 0;
            txwait <= 0;
        end else begin
            if (txwait) begin
                tx_start <= 0;
                txbot <= txbot + 1;
                txwait <= 0;
            end else if (!tx_busy && (txtop != txbot)) begin
                tx_start <= 1;
                txwait <= 1;
            end
        end
    end
